target: Apple TV (tvOS) home and TV app layout, per the platform's published design guidelines, 1920x1080
sources: Apple Human Interface Guidelines, Layout, tvOS (updated September 9, 2026), https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/layout: safe area 60 pt top and bottom, 80 pt sides; grids two to nine columns at 860, 560, 410, 320, 260, 217, 184, 160 pt wide with 40 pt horizontal spacing and at least 100 pt between rows (tvOS draws 1 pt as 1 px at 1080p)
Layout only: no artwork, icons, sounds, fonts or names from the target are used

measurements.insets: content 80 px from the sides, 60 px from the top and bottom
measurements.poster rows: the six-column grid: 260 px wide (2:3, 390 tall), 40 apart, from x 80
measurements.16:9 rows: the four-column grid: 410 px wide (231 tall), 40 apart
measurements.rows: at least 100 px between the bottom of an unfocused row and the next row's top, more for titled rows
measurements.motion: not specified by the guidelines; not checked
